title: Group Words by Length
hints: String::length is a method reference: it's the same as word -> word.length().
groupingBy keeps the words of each group in the order they appear in the stream.
Use TreeMap::new as the second argument to get the lengths sorted.

mustContain.message: Use the Stream API, for example Arrays.stream(...) or list.stream().

mustNotContain.message: Solve it without for or while loops: use stream operations instead.

tests.input: one two three four five six
tests.output:
3: one, two, six
4: four, five
5: three
